The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Staff Software Engineer - Onsite Messaging
description:
We’re excited to welcome our first Staff Software Engineer to the newly forming Onsite Messaging team at Voyado.
   

  

 Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.
   

  

 We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a Staff Engineer role for someone who enjoys leading through technology.
   

  

 You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.
   

  

 Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.
   

  

 Onsite Messaging also sits on a shared JavaScript foundation that several Voyado products load on retailer sites. Getting that foundation into good shape — as a platform other teams can build on — is part of this role.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone operating at around 8-10 years of engineering experience, who has been the person other engineers turn to on hard system design questions.
   

  

 You Don’t Need Experience From Our Exact Technology Stack, But We Believe You’ve Worked With Several Of The Following
   

  

* Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
* JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed
* AWS, and serverless architecture in particular — our backend runs on that. Experience with Azure or GCP equivalents is fine if you're happy to work in AWS
* Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
* System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
* CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices


**We Also Think You**
* have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
* enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
* communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
* thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
* enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
* use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code


**High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.**
 You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.
   

  

 At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
   

  

**Some Of Our Benefits**
* 30 days of vacation
* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities
* Four days from the office and one day from home


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
   

  

 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
   

  

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Fantastic! 🎉
   

  

 Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
   

  

 Making it personal with AI
   

  

 We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
*Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.*
**Om tjänsten**
 Fortnox behöver förstå hur våra produkter skapar värde, och det börjar med data som går att lita på. Produktanalysteamet bygger den grunden, och vi söker en Analytics Engineer som äger den. Det du modellerar i dbt idag blir kontextlagret som AI-agenter konsumerar imorgon.
   

  

 Vi söker en person som trivs i en teknisk roll och vill bygga datafundamentet för att:
   

  

* Bygga datamodeller i dbt och BigQuery. Basmodeller som hela organisationen konsumerar. Tydliga namn, dokumentation och tester.
* Få in och modellera event-data. Du tar Kafka backend-events och Piwik frontend-events hela vägen in i BQ/dbt och bygger affärslogiken ovanpå: aktivering, inloggning och hur kunder rör sig genom produkterna.
* Äga produktdomänen i dataplattformen. Du ansvarar för struktur, standards och kvalitet för allt som rör produkt, så att andra team kan lita på modellerna.
* Göra datan användbar för både människor och AI. Vi bygger en AI-driven pipeline för mätning. Du säkrar att modeller och events är dokumenterade så att relevanta stakeholders förstår dem, och så att en AI-agent svarar rätt på frågor om dem.
* Hjälpa team hjälpa sig själva. Du bygger verktygen och kontexten som låter produktteam lägga till mätning och hämta data på egen hand.


**Om dig**
 Du har erfarenhet av att bygga dbt-modeller i produktion, med SQL som primärt verktyg. Det som gör dig intressant för oss är att du vet skillnaden mellan en modell som råkar vara korrekt och en som faktiskt är användbar, för en analytiker, en produktägare eller en AI-agent.
   

  

 Du har jobbat med event-data och vet hur stökig den kan vara: många events som triggas olika, och sällan dokumentation som reder ut det. Du förstår affären bakom datan och frågar "vilken affärsfråga besvarar den här modellen?" innan du bygger den.
   

  

 Du kan förklara vad du byggt för någon som inte jobbar med data varje dag, och säga nej när det behövs.
   

  

 Du bryr dig om kvalitet och reagerar när namngivning är inkonsekvent, dokumentation saknas eller en definition inte hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du kommunicerar flytande i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.
   

  

 Vi ser det även som positivt om du har: erfarenhet av BigQuery/GCP. Nyfikenhet på att bygga BI-as-code, istället för att klicka i ett BI-verktyg. Vi tittar på verktyg i den riktningen, som Lightdash eller Evidence, och på rapportering direkt via Claude. Vana att jobba med AI-verktyg på riktigt: bryta ner uppgifter, ge kontext, validera resultat. Lust att läsa i kodbasen för att förstå var events triggas och var datan kommer ifrån.
   

  

 Vi jobbar med dbt, BigQuery, Piwik Pro och AI-verktyg för kodning och analys.
   

  

**Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet**
*Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.*
*Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.*
**Urvalsprocessen beräknar vi påbörja i mitten av augusti, därför kan återkoppling på din ansökan dröja.**
**Behandling av personuppgifter**
 Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Personuppgiftsansvarig är det bolag som du söker arbete hos och är något bolag inom Fortnoxkoncernen. Du kan läsa integritetsmeddelandet i sin helhet på följande länk:
   

  

 https://apps.fortnox.se/api/eula/document-v1/privacy-policy-recruiting

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
We are super excited to announce that Robin Bodin is now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Insights & Activation product area, focused on building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, predictive models, and future AI capabilities across Voyado Engage.
   

  

 Our mission is to make analytics data reliable, governed, and actionable end to end — from canonical data products and semantic standards to the metrics and insights surfaced to customers. As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.
   

  

 We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.
   

  

 Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.
   

  

 As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers
   

  

**Some Of The Things You'll Be Up To**
* Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
* Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
* Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
* Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
* Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
* Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities


 So, who are you?
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.
   

  

 You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.
   

  

 At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.
   

  

**Besides The Above, We Believe You've Got**
* Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
* Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
* Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
* Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
* Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery


 Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 Voyado Wouldn’t Be The Powerful Platform It Is Without The People Behind It. We Really Care For Our Voyadoers And Some Examples Of What We Can Offer You Are
   

  

* An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
* Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
* Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
* An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.


**Some Of Our Benefits**
* 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
* Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
* Breakfast buffet on Fridays
* Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
* A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
* 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
* Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
* A wellness hour you can use every week


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.
   

  

 With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.
   

  

 Ready to find out more?
   

  

 Lovely! 🎉
   

  

*Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!*
**Making it personal with AI**
 We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.
